macros.name: tkzAutoLabelPoints
macros.doc: The label of a point is placed in a direction defined by a center and a point center. The distance to the point is determined by a percentage of the distance between the center and the point.

macros.name: tkzClipBB
macros.doc: The idea is to limit future constructions to the current bounding box.

macros.name: tkzCompass
macros.doc: This macro allows you to leave a compass trace, i.e. an arc at a designated point.

macros.name: tkzDefCircle
macros.doc: This macro allows you to retrieve the characteristics (center and radius) of certain circles.

macros.name: tkzDefGoldenRectangle
macros.doc: The macro determines a rectangle whose size ratio is the number Φ. The created points are in tkzFirstPointResult and tkzSecondPointResult.

macros.name: tkzDefPoint
macros.doc: The \tkzDefPoint macro is used to define a point by assigning coordinates to it.

macros.name: tkzDefPoints
macros.doc: Points can be specified in any of the following ways: – Cartesian coordinates; – Polar coordinates; – Named points; – Relative points.

macros.name: tkzDefPointsBy
macros.doc: There are two macros, one for the transformation of a single point \tkzDefPointBy and the other for the transformation of a list of points \tkzDefPointsBy.

macros.name: tkzDefRadicalAxis
macros.doc: \tkzDefRadicalAxis(A,B)(C,D) gives the radical axis of the two circles C (A, B) and C (C, D).

macros.name: tkzDefRandPointOn
macros.doc: The result is a point with a random position that can be named with the macro \tkzGetPoint.

macros.name: tkzDefRectangle
macros.doc: From two points, two more points are obtained such that the four taken in order form a rectangle.

macros.name: tkzDefSquare
macros.doc: From two points, two more points are obtained such that the four taken in order form a square.

macros.name: tkzDefTriangle
macros.doc: This macro makes it possible to associate to a pair of points a third point in order to define a certain triangle \tkzDefTriangle(A,B).

macros.name: tkzDrawArc
macros.doc: This macro traces the arc of center O. Depending on the options, the arguments differ.

macros.name: tkzDrawPoint
macros.doc: \tkzDrawPoint for a single point or \tkzDrawPoints for one or more points.

macros.name: tkzFindSlopeAngle
macros.doc: Determines the slope of the straight line (AB).

macros.name: tkzGetAngle
macros.doc: Assigns the value in degree of an angle to a macro.

macros.name: tkzGetVectxy
macros.doc: Retrieving the coordinates of a vector.

macros.name: tkzInit
macros.doc: The initial bounding box after using the macro \tkzInit is defined by the rectangle based on the points (0, 0) and (10, 10). The \tkzInit macro allows this initial bounding box to be modified using the arguments (xmin, xmax, ymin, and ymax).

macros.name: tkzInterLL
macros.doc: Defines the intersection point tkzPointResult of the two lines (AB) and (CD).

macros.name: tkzIsOrtho
macros.doc: \tkzIsOrtho allows to test the orthogonality of lines (pt1pt2) and (pt1pt3).

macros.name: tkzLabelArc
macros.doc: This macro allows you to place a label along an arc.

macros.name: tkzLabelSegment
macros.doc: This macro allows you to place a label along a segment or a line.

macros.name: tkzPicAngle
macros.doc: If you prefer to use Tik Z library angles, you can mark angles with the macro \tkzPicAngle and \tkzPicRightAngle.

macros.name: tkzSetUpColors
macros.doc: The macro \tkzSetUpColors allows you to set the background color as well as the text color.

macros.name: tkzSetUpLabel
macros.doc: The macro \tkzSetUpLabel is used to define the style of the point labels.

macros.name: tkzSetUpLine
macros.doc: It is a macro that allows you to define the style of all the lines.

macros.name: tkzShowBB
macros.doc: This macro displays the bounding box.
